title: Biorthogonal curvature
exact_target: Can the product of a sphere and a torus carry a Riemannian metric for which the average curvature of every pair of complementary orthogonal two-planes is positive?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 6800004 (AMR-067-0004). CC BY 4.0.

Alexander Pigazzini, \emph{Positive Biorthogonal Curvature on $S^2\times T^2$ via Affine Connection}, arXiv:2502.11914v11 (2025), Section 1, printed p. 1, and Section 1.2, ``Problem (Bettiol, 2017)'', p. 3.
